name: Shiranami Yukino
source:
Affiliation: Elusion
Post: Vice-Captain
Birthplace: Japan (Tokyo)

A sharp man who was chosen to be the Vice-Captain of the Elusion to support and help guide the novice protagonist.
He's a serious guy who puts utmost importance towards following the rules.
